messages:
maria: Quick question — security is proposing a rolling retention policy for SIEM-exported logs: default 90d for high-traffic events, 365d for infra alerts, and 2y for legally required evidence. Need feedback on RBAC and KMS unwrapping for short-lived analyst access.
jon: do we have a concrete enforcement plan? who will own the exports?
maria: ops would own exports; security owns policy. Biggest open items: 1) how are analysts granted read access for incident triage? 2) how do we gate exported archives to partners w/ DLP? 3) KMS wrapping for long-term buckets.
kevin: +1. For analysts, we should use JIT access via ticketing with timeboxed CMK grants. We already have an ephemeral-kms-proxy service — can we reuse that?
maria: yes, thinking reuse. Sketch of flow:
- request via ticketing -> approval -> ephemeral role issued (1h) -> KMS unwrap via proxy -> SIEM view
jon: ping @lee for RBAC impact on our Splunk ingest roles.
lee: FYI Splunk indexes map to AWS accounts. RBAC change needs a migration step: create 'analyst-ephemeral' role in IAM with AssumeRoleWithSAML for one-hour sessions. We must update docs and Terraform.
maria: Also need to redact sensitive fields before export to partners. Proposed: PII scrub in pipeline + enrichment tag so exports are labelled 'scrubbed' vs 'forensic'.
kevin: For forensic buckets that are 2y, KMS must use a dedicated CMK with stricter rotation and emergency rotation playbook. Audit-bot: CMK rotation event will create an alert in #eng-security.
audit-bot: ALERT: policy-change-CMK rotation scheduled for 2026-07-01. Tag: cryptography.
jon: Can someone prototype the ticket -> ephemeral role flow? A sample request payload for the proxy would help.
maria: I'll drop a small curl example in the ticket:
```
curl -X POST https://ephemeral-proxy.internal/unwrap -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TICKET_TOKEN' -d '{"bucket":"forensics-2024","duration":3600,"reason":"incident triage #1234"}'
```
lee: also need audit logs for each unwrap call stored in a separate, immutable bucket for 5y (audit trail). That bucket should have MFA delete on.
kevin: Agree. Also flag: partner exports need timeboxed signed URLs not permanent creds. Use presigned URLs that expire <24h and rotate the signing key weekly.
maria: ok actionable list:
1) jon + lee: Terraform for analyst-ephemeral role + Splunk index RBAC migration
2) kevin: CMK segregation & emergency rotation doc
3) maria: ticket template + curl example + DLP scrub checklist
4) audit-bot: ensure unwrap audit events sent to audit-bucket with immutability
jon: I'll start a PR for the Terraform change. Tagging @kevin for review once draft exists :tm: 
kevin: will review. one more: can we auto-revoke sessions after policy-change detections? maybe a lambda to scan active sessions.
maria: noted. Thanks all — will file follow-up RFC and assign owners.
lee: 👍
kevin: :thumbsup:
jon: thanks!
